note: Hand-written context of each text of en.json, in ASD-STE100: what kind of text it is, where it shows, what it does for the user, and what each value holds. en_hash is the hash of the English text that the context was written for (L4g). Draft until approved.

api.request.timed_out_try_again.does: The app sent a request to the server and got no answer in time. The user can try the same action again.

api.request.network_error_check_the.does: The phone could not reach the server. The user must check the internet connection.

api.analyze.stopped.screen: Camera, while the photo is checked
api.analyze.stopped.does: The user stopped the food check of a photo. Internal; the app usually does not show it.

api.analyze.timed_out_try_again.screen: Camera, while the photo is checked
api.analyze.timed_out_try_again.does: The food check of a photo took too long. The photo is kept. The user can send it again.

api.analyze.try_again.screen: Camera, while the photo is checked
api.analyze.try_again.does: The server lost the food check job. The photo is kept. The user can send it again.

api.photoUrl.photo.does: The app could not load the photo of a listing. Developer text.

api.photoUrl.photo_read_failed.does: The app could not read a downloaded photo. Developer text.

capture.elapsedText.screen: Camera, while the photo is checked
capture.elapsedText.does: A time in seconds with one decimal, added after 'Analyzing…', for example '2.4 s'. 's' is the symbol for seconds.

FORM_WORDS.title.does: The title of the food item is empty or too long. It must have 1 to 80 characters.

FORM_WORDS.servings.does: The number of servings is not a whole number from 1 to 99.

FORM_WORDS.pickup.does: The pickup details are empty or too long. They must have 1 to 200 characters.

capture.sourceNote.from_the_barcode.does: Tells where the title of the item came from: the product barcode that the camera read.

capture.sourceNote.the_scanner_says.does: Tells where the title came from: the food scanner described the photo with these words.

values.description: a short description of the food in English from the scanner

clipsession.a_recording_is_already.does: The microphone is already recording. Developer text.

clipsession.the_recording_was_cancelled.does: The voice recording stopped before it ended. Developer text.

clipsession.not_recording.does: The app tried to stop a recording that did not start. Developer text.

logic.retryText.the_scanner_is_busy.does: The food scanner has too much work. The user must wait some seconds. The photo stays in the app, so the user does not need to take it again.

logic.retryText.too_many_photos_this.does: The user sent too many photos in one minute. The user must wait one minute. The photo stays in the app, so the user does not need to take it again.

logic.retryText.the_food_check_is.does: The food check service is not available now. The photo stays in the app, so the user does not need to take it again.

logic.retryText.this_photo_took_too.does: The check of this photo took too long. A closer photo with fewer items helps. The photo stays in the app, so the user does not need to take it again.

logic.retryText.the_food_scanner_is.does: The food scanner had a server error. The user can try again. The photo stays in the app, so the user does not need to take it again.

logic.retryText.your_photo_is_kept.does: Added after the error text of the server: the photo stays in the app, so the user does not need to take it again.

values.p1: the error text of the server, or 'Request failed (502)'

logic.retryText.request_failed.does: The food check failed with an HTTP error. Then the app adds ' — your photo is kept.'

logic.foundTitle.item_found.does: Title of the review list. The app shows '1 item found'. Noun phrase, singular.

logic.foundTitle.items_found.does: Title of the review list. The app shows '{n} items found', for example '3 items found'. Plural.

logic.postTitle.post.does: Button. Verb in the imperative: the user posts all the items as listings now. {plural} is '1 listing' or '3 listings'.

values.plural: a count and a noun, for example '3 listings'

logic.postTitle.listing.does: Noun, singular: one food offer that other users can see and grab. Goes in the button 'Post 1 listing'.

logic.postTitle.listings.does: Noun, plural: food offers that other users can see and grab. Goes in the button 'Post 3 listings'.

logic.postingText.does: Shows progress while the app posts the items one by one.

values.i: the number of the item that posts now

logic.notPostedTitle.item_not_posted.does: Title after a post with errors: '1 item not posted'. Singular.

logic.notPostedTitle.items_not_posted.does: Title after a post with errors: '2 items not posted'. Plural.

logic.postedSummary.listing.does: Noun, singular, in the line '1 listing posted. ...'

logic.postedSummary.listings.does: Noun, plural, in the line '3 listings posted. ...'

logic.postedSummary.1_item_is.does: Start of the clause '1 item is kept here'. Singular subject and verb.

logic.postedSummary.items_are.does: Start of the clause '2 items are kept here'. Plural subject and verb 'are' (the items stay; they are not posted).

values.left: the number of items that did not post

logic.postedSummary.posted_kept_here_try.does: Some items posted, some did not. The items that did not post stay on the screen. The user can try again.

values.p2: for example '1 item is' or '2 items are'

FIXED_TEXT.401.does: The session is not valid. The user must sign in again.

FIXED_TEXT.429.does: The user sent too many requests. The user must wait one minute.

logic.errorMessage.the_food_scanner_is.does: The food scanner server is busy. The user can try again.

logic.errorMessage.the_service_is_busy.does: A server of the app is busy. The user can try again.

logic.errorMessage.request_failed.does: A request failed with an HTTP error number.

SIGN_IN.title.does: Title of the first screen. Tells what the app does: people share food or find food.

SIGN_IN.line.does: Tells the user: the same form signs in to an account or makes a new account.

SIGN_IN.email.does: Label of the email address field.

SIGN_IN.emailHint.does: Example text in the empty email field. An example email address; keep it as an email address.

SIGN_IN.rule.does: Tells the minimum length of the password.

SIGN_IN.incomplete.does: The email or the password is missing or too short.

SIGN_IN.badEmail.does: The text in the email field is not an email address. Keep the example address as it is.

SIGN_IN.waiting.does: Shows on the Continue button while the app signs the user in.

SIGN_IN.noAccount.does: No account has this email and password. The link 'Create one' follows on the same line.

SIGN_IN.create.does: Link after 'No account found.': makes a new account with the email and password in the form. 'one' means an account.

SIGN_IN.go.does: Main button. Signs in with the email and password. Verb or short action word.

SIGN_IN.show.does: Shows the password as plain text. One short verb.

SIGN_IN.hide.does: Hides the password again. One short verb.

SIGN_IN.showName.does: What a screen reader says for the Show button: shows the password.

SIGN_IN.hideName.does: What a screen reader says for the Hide button: hides the password.

RESET.forgot.does: Opens the screen to reset a forgotten password. A question.

RESET.askTitle.does: Title of the screen where the user asks for a reset link.

RESET.askLine.does: Tells the user: the app sends a link to the email address.

RESET.send.does: Sends the reset link to the email in the field. Verb in the imperative.

RESET.sending.does: Shows on the Send link button while the app sends.

RESET.back.does: Goes back to the sign-in screen. The user does not reset the password.

RESET.sentTitle.does: Title after the link is sent. Tells the user to look in the email inbox.

RESET.sent.does: Tells the user that a link is on its way if an account uses this email, and how long the link works.

values.email: the email address the user typed

RESET.newTitle.does: Title of the screen where the user types a new password (opened from the link in the email).

RESET.newLine.does: Tells the minimum length of the new password.

RESET.newPassword.does: Label of the field for the new password.

RESET.save.does: Saves the new password. Verb in the imperative.

RESET.saving.does: Shows on the Save password button while the app saves.

RESET.short.does: The new password is too short.

RESET.expired.does: The reset link is too old or was already used. The link 'Send a new link' follows on the same line.

RESET.again.does: Goes back to ask for a new reset link.

ui.Shutter.does: What a screen reader says for the round shutter button: takes a photo.

ui.ReviewCard.title_of_item.does: Screen reader label of the title field of item {n} in the review list.

values.n: the item number in the list: 1, 2, 3 ...

ui.ReviewCard.remove_item.does: Screen reader label of the X button that removes item {n} from the review list. The item is not posted.

values.n: the item number in the list: 1, 2, 3 ...

ui.ReviewCard.fewer_servings_of_item.does: Screen reader label of the minus button: one serving less for item {n}.

values.n: the item number in the list: 1, 2, 3 ...

ui.ReviewCard.servings_of_item.does: Screen reader label of the servings number field of item {n}.

values.n: the item number in the list: 1, 2, 3 ...

ui.ReviewCard.more_servings_of_item.does: Screen reader label of the plus button: one serving more for item {n}.

values.n: the item number in the list: 1, 2, 3 ...

voicerec.start.allow_the_microphone_to.does: The user did not allow the microphone. The user must allow it to give changes by voice.

voicerec.start.the_microphone_did_not.does: The microphone did not start recording.

webcam.frame.no_canvas.does: The browser could not make a picture from the camera. Developer text; the ui branch will replace it.

webcam.frame.no_blob.does: The browser could not save the camera picture as a file. Developer text; the ui branch will replace it.

webcam.no_canvas.does: The browser could not make a picture from the camera. Developer text; the ui branch will replace it.

webcam.no_blob.does: The browser could not save the camera picture as a file. Developer text; the ui branch will replace it.

webvoice.startWebCapture.this_browser_ca.does: This browser cannot record sound on this page. The page must use https.

webvoice.startWebCapture.allow_the_micro.does: The user did not allow the microphone in the browser. The user must allow it to give changes by voice.

webvoice.startWebCapture.the_microphone_.does: The microphone did not start recording in the browser.
The microphone did not start recording in the browser.

ROLE.title.does: Title of the menu where the user picks a role: give food or receive food.

ROLE.give.does: Role: the user offers food to other people. One verb.

ROLE.receive.does: Role: the user finds and takes food that other people offer. One verb.

ROLE.logout.does: Signs the user out of the account. The user goes back to the sign-in screen. Not 'sign in'.

ROLE.close.does: Closes the role menu. The role does not change.

ROLE.selected.does: Said after the role card that is chosen now. Adjective: chosen, active.

ROLE.change.does: Not used by any screen now (words.ts only). Meaning: opens the role menu to pick the other role.

FRAME.brand.does: The app name. Do not translate.

FRAME.menu.does: The menu button with three lines. Opens the role menu.

FRAME.tabs.does: Name of the tab group with the two roles Give and Receive. Noun, plural.

FRAME.expired.does: The sign-in session ended. The user must sign in again.

RECEIVE.title.does: Title of the list of food offers that people can take now.

RECEIVE.empty.does: No food is offered now. The user can look again later.

RECEIVE.grab.does: Button on a food card. The user takes this food offer for himself or herself. Short verb.

RECEIVE.grabbing.does: Shows on the Grab button while the app takes the offer.

RECEIVE.gone.does: Another user took this food first, or the offer ended.

RECEIVE.grabbed.screen: Receive screen, sheet after a grab
RECEIVE.grabbed.does: The user took the food offer. Next the user goes to the pickup place or sends a message to the giver.

RECEIVE.maps.screen: Receive screen, sheet after a grab
RECEIVE.maps.does: Opens the pickup place in a maps app.

RECEIVE.chat.screen: Receive screen, sheet after a grab
RECEIVE.chat.does: Opens WhatsApp with a message to the giver. Brand name, do not translate.

RECEIVE.close.screen: Receive screen, sheet after a grab
RECEIVE.close.does: Closes the sheet. The grab stays.

RECEIVE.yours.does: This food offer is from the user. The user cannot grab it.

RECEIVE.collected.does: State of a food offer: the receiver picked up the food. Past participle.

RECEIVE.expired.does: State of a food offer: its time ended and nobody picked it up.

RECEIVE.timeLeft.does: Said before the minutes and seconds that the offer stays up.

words.servings.1_serving.does: The amount of food: one portion for one person.

words.servings.servings.does: The amount of food: portions for {n} people.

words.grabMessage.does: The message that the receiver sends to the giver after a grab. Friendly, short, first person.

values.title: the food title
values.pickup_text: where to collect, typed by the giver

GIVE.title.does: Title of the list of food offers that the user posted.

GIVE.empty.does: The user has no food offers yet. Tells how to make one.

GIVE.add.does: Opens the camera to make a new food offer. '+' then a noun phrase.

words.postedText.listings_are_posted_the.does: Short message after the post: several food offers are up now for 30 minutes.

words.postedText.listed_it_stays_up.does: Short message after the post: one food offer is up now for 30 minutes.

CAPTURE.hint.does: Tells the user what to do: aim at a product barcode or take a photo of the food.

CAPTURE.dropHint.does: Added after the hint: the user can also drag an image file onto the page.

CAPTURE.dropNow.does: Shows while the user drags a file over the page: let go to use the image.

CAPTURE.close.does: The X button. Closes the camera; no listing is made.

CAPTURE.upload.does: Opens the photo library to pick a photo that is on the device.

CAPTURE.shoot.does: The shutter button: takes a photo now.

CAPTURE.cancel.does: Closes the camera card; no listing is made.

CAPTURE.allow.does: The app needs camera access to take a photo.

CAPTURE.allowLink.does: Asks the phone for camera access.

CAPTURE.blocked.does: Camera access is off in the phone settings. The user can still upload a photo.

CAPTURE.shotFailed.does: The camera did not take the photo. The user can try again.

CAPTURE.use.does: Question: does the user want to send this photo to the food check?

CAPTURE.again.does: Question after an error: does the user want to send the same photo again?

CAPTURE.retake.does: Throws away this photo and opens the camera to take a new photo. Short verb phrase.

CAPTURE.usePhoto.does: Sends this photo to the food check.

CAPTURE.tryAgain.does: Sends the same photo to the food check again.

CAPTURE.barcode.does: Shows the barcode number that the camera read.

CAPTURE.analyzing.does: Shows while the food check runs. The app adds the seconds, for example 'Analyzing… 2.4 s'.

CAPTURE.notFood.does: The photo shows no food. Asks the user to take a photo of a food item.

CAPTURE.notFoodLine.does: Explains the title 'Try a food item'.

CAPTURE.noNameOne.does: The scanner sees food but cannot name the one item.

CAPTURE.noNameOneLine.does: Tells the user how to fix it: a closer photo.

CAPTURE.noNameMany.does: The scanner sees several items but cannot name them.

CAPTURE.noNameManyLine.does: Tells the user how to fix it: a closer photo with fewer items.

CAPTURE.listed.does: The user already posted this item and it is still up.

CAPTURE.listedLine.does: Explains: the item is in the user's list. 'Your listings' is the name of the Give screen.

CAPTURE.seeMine.does: Closes the camera and shows the user's own food offers (the Give screen).

CAPTURE.paused.does: The food scanner stopped for today because the daily limit is reached.

CAPTURE.pausedLine.does: Explains: the photo scanner stops until tomorrow; reading a barcode still works.

CAPTURE.closeFlow.does: Closes the camera; no listing is made.

REVIEW.one.does: Title of the form for one food offer before it is posted.

REVIEW.check.does: Asks the user to check each item and remove the items that the user does not want to share.

REVIEW.title.does: Label of the field with the name of the food item.

REVIEW.servings.does: Label of the number of portions.

REVIEW.fewer.does: The minus button: one serving less.

REVIEW.more.does: The plus button: one serving more.

REVIEW.pickup.does: Label of the field: where and how the receiver collects the food.

REVIEW.pickupAll.does: Label of the one pickup field that applies to all items.

REVIEW.pickupHint.does: Example text in the empty pickup field. Gives a sample place. Adapt the street example to the language.

REVIEW.startOver.does: Throws away this review and opens the camera again.

REVIEW.post.does: Posts the food offer now so that other users can see it. Verb in the imperative and a noun.

REVIEW.posting.does: Shows on the post button while the app posts.

REVIEW.notPosted.does: This item did not post. It stays in the list so the user can try again.

REVIEW.nonePosted.does: No item posted. The user can try again.

TOUCH.light.does: Starts a touch-up that makes the photo brighter.

TOUCH.background.does: Starts a touch-up that puts a plain background behind the food.

TOUCH.original.does: The photo as the user took it. Noun or adjective.

TOUCH.edit.does: The photo after the touch-up. Past participle.

TOUCH.choose.does: Asks the user to pick one of two photos for the post.

TOUCH.kept.does: The app did not use the touch-up because it changed the food. The original photo stays.

TOUCH.failed.does: The touch-up failed. The original photo stays.

TOUCH.busy.does: The touch-up service is busy. The user can try again in one minute.

TOUCH.paused.does: The touch-up stopped for today because the daily limit is reached.

TOUCH.wait.does: The user tapped post while a touch-up still runs. The user must wait.

TOUCH.ofItem.does: Added to a screen reader label to tell which item, for example 'Better light of item 2'.

VOICE.say.does: Tells the user to say the changes for the listing out loud.

VOICE.start.does: The microphone button: starts the recording.

VOICE.stop.does: The stop button: ends the recording.

VOICE.listening.does: The app records now. A tap on the button stops it.

VOICE.heard.does: Shows the words that the app heard, in quotes.

values.t: the spoken words, in the user's language

VOICE.apply.does: Applies all the proposed changes to the listing form.

VOICE.keep.does: Ignores the proposed changes. The form stays as it is.

VOICE.ok.does: Closes the voice result when nothing changes.

VOICE.micOff.does: The microphone is not allowed. The user must allow it.

VOICE.failed.does: The app could not read the recording. The user can try again.

VOICE.noSpeech.does: The recording had no speech. The user can try again.

VOICE.busy.does: The voice service is busy. The user can try again in one minute.

VOICE.paused.does: Voice changes stopped for today because the daily limit is reached.

VOICE.rename.does: One line in the list of proposed changes: the title of item {n} changes from one name to another.

VOICE.servings.does: The number of servings of item {n} changes.

VOICE.remove.does: Item {n} is removed from the list.

VOICE.pickup.does: The pickup details change to this text.

VOICE.question.does: The app did not understand a part and shows it as a question.

VOICE.notAdded.does: The user asked for a new item by voice. The app does not add it, because a listing needs a photo.

VOICE.removedBefore.does: A change was for an item that the user already removed, so the app does not use it.

VOICE.dropped.does: A part of the speech that the app does not use.

VOICE.unnamed.does: Name for an item with no title, sent to the voice service: 'Item 2'.

VOICE.first.does: The user tapped post before deciding about the voice changes. The user must apply or keep them first.

VOICE.none.does: The app found no change in the speech.
